Overview

Legendary Assassin (Prime) is a MythicalMythical unit. He can be obtained by evolving Legendary Assassin.

Evolving

Legendary Assassin (Prime) can be evolved from Legendary Assassin with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Legendary Assassin

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

(This is w/o Legendary Assassin's passive).

Passive

Slim Down - Every time Legendary Assassin (Prime) attacks, he increases his damage by 0.8% maxing at 200%. Every other upgrade changes the value of increase, up to a max of 2% per attack. Once he reaches 100%, another 100% will be added to his damage and his model will change into a slimmer version of himself, representing Legendary Assassin (Prime) in his prime.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • This unit currently deals 2x its displayed damage at upgrade 6-7.
  • When applying a damage buff to him, only his base damage will be affected. This means that even at maximum passive ( Slim Down ), only one-third of his displayed damage will be buffed, rather than his total damage.
  • His shiny skin is based on a version of Sakamoto in a flashback to before he met his wife, and was still in his "Prime". This skin is seemingly unaffected by the Slim Down passive's change of model at max efficiency.
  • The most efficient way to max out the damage gained by the Slim Down passive is by stopping at Upgrade 6; No Refunds, as it buffs his damage by 1.8% every 5 seconds, as compared to Upgrade 8; Slim Down's increase of 2% every 7.8 seconds, making Upgrade 6 44% faster than Upgrade 8, assuming enemies are perpetually within this unit's range.
